claims.text: In heads-up play, the button posts the small blind, receives the last hole card, acts first before the flop, and acts last on later betting rounds.
source_locators: 2024 Rules, Rule 34B: Button Placement and Movement
limitations: The cited rulebook is tournament-specific; the app exposes its own narrower versioned heads-up rules contract.

claims.text: Because the button receives the last card in a two-player deal, the big blind receives the first and third cards from a fixed deck while the button receives the second and fourth.
limitations: This describes physical deal order, not card strength or strategic advantage.

claims.text: Position changes action order and therefore which action is observed before a decision; position alone does not determine the best poker action.
limitations: No opening range, equity threshold, or solver recommendation is asserted.

rights.source_reproduction: No rulebook text is reproduced beyond a short locator-level paraphrase.
